top_signals.title: US Crude Oil Inventories See Massive Drop Off
top_signals.summary: The American Petroleum Institute (API) estimated that crude oil inventories in the United States fell by a massive 11.12 million barrels in the week ending October 9. In the week prior, US crude oil inventories fell by 2.09 million barrels. Commercial crude oil inventories excluding the SPR have lost more than 51 million barrels over the last 26 weeks, but US crude inventories are at roughly the same level as they were at the beginning of the year, according to API data, kept in check in part thanks to draws from the SPR. top_signals.summary: Recorded Black Sea steel loadings declined sharply in Q3 2026. Volumes, including scrap, fell 65.6% y/y to 0.65 Mt across 51 voyages, compared with 129 in Q3 2025.
